questions.title: Planning an experiment — turntable & dropped putty

parts.label: (a)
parts.answer:
Diagram: a horizontal turntable (base and motor on the bench) driven by a d.c. motor via a belt; the motor terminals connected to a d.c. supply; point P marked a distance r from the centre C; a sphere of adhesive putty dropped onto the turntable at P.
Procedure and measurements: rotate the turntable at a fixed frequency f₀, then switch off the motor and drop a putty sphere of mass m onto the turntable at P, measuring the new frequency f. Vary m (independent variable) and measure f (dependent variable), keeping f₀ and r constant. Measure m with a top-pan balance. Measure f (and f₀) by timing n revolutions with a stopwatch (T = t/n, f = 1/T = n/t). Measure r with a rule.
Analysis: plot a graph of 1/f against m. The relationship is valid if a straight line is produced (with a non-zero y-intercept). From 1/f = β/f₀ + r²m/(Kf₀): gradient = r²/(Kf₀), so K = r²/(f₀ × gradient); y-intercept = β/f₀, so β = f₀ × y-intercept.
Controls: keep f₀ and r constant. Keep f₀ constant by adjusting the rheostat to keep the motor current constant (check the ammeter). Ensure the putty is always dropped at the same distance r (a fixed location above P, or a circle of radius r drawn on the turntable).
Safety: the putty may leave the turntable — use screens/cushions around the apparatus; clamp the motor/turntable to the bench; lubricate the turntable to reduce friction. Repeat each measurement for the same m and average f.

questions.title: Analysis of data — double-slit interference & wavelength

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.answer: Plot the six points of y against 1/s (within half a small square), each with a horizontal error bar on 1/s.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.answer: Draw a straight line of best fit and a worst acceptable line (steepest/shallowest line through all the error bars).

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.answer: gradient ≈ 0.58 mm² (from Δy/Δx over more than half the line's length). Absolute uncertainty = gradient of best fit − gradient of worst acceptable line.

parts.label: (f)
parts.answer:
s = λD/y = gradient/y = 0.58 mm²/5.00 mm
= 1.2 × 10⁻⁴ m (using y = 0.500 cm = 5.00 mm).
